desc: Derive and implement a genuinely worst-case efficient dynamic algorithm for weighted monotone-grid path sums under adjacent-walk updates.
Exploit the adjacent-walk property to reduce local update work below the current \(O(B^2)\) per update, or replace the block method with a separator/transfer-matrix approach.
Establish the weighted-DAG forward/reverse DP representation and handle zero values and repeated updates without division.
Validate the current implementation against both public samples.
Validate the final algorithm on \(2\times2\), rectangular, all-zero, boundary-walk, source/sink-update, and repeated-visit cases.
Assess Python time and memory complexity at maximum constraints.
